custom.title: Need a different fit?
custom.text: Other bay counts, battery types or an insert for your case. Tell me what you use and I'll make it fit.

faq.a: Use the order form on this site or email info@3deca.com. I'll confirm your order and send payment details.

faq.q: Are prices with or without VAT?
faq.a: All prices are ex VAT. Contact me if you need a commercial invoice.
Shipping within the EU is free on orders above €130. For smaller orders or shipping outside the EU, ask and I'll let you know.

faq.q: Can you make a custom size or fit?
faq.a: Yes. Storage boxes and caddies come in different bay counts, and I can make inserts for your case. Send me your setup.

faq.q: What are the products made of?
faq.a: Carbon / nylon. The Euronorm case support for the Sennheiser caddy is made of ABS.

reviews.quote: It's a very well-thought-out bit of kit and clearly coming from someone with experience on set with very specific things he needed to make things easier. My favourite bit so far is the threaded ZMT mount with a magnetic back. Works very well for sticking it to the ceiling and doors for plant mics. Love the threaded hole for connecting it to different types of arms. The magnet is really strong. No flimsy stuff. Also one of the cleanest 3D print finishes I've seen so far.
